credentials_value_check.name: credentials_value_check
credentials_value_check.value: ("credentials"."deleted_at" is null) = ("credentials"."ciphertext" is not null) and ("credentials"."ciphertext" is null) = ("credentials"."nonce" is null)

items_triage_check.name: items_triage_check
items_triage_check.value: "items"."action_id" is null or ("items"."decide_by" is null and "items"."snoozed_until" is null)

agent_cancellations_who_check.name: agent_cancellations_who_check
agent_cancellations_who_check.value: "agent_cancellations"."source" not in ('person', 'admin') or "agent_cancellations"."who" is not null

agent_proposals_offer_check.name: agent_proposals_offer_check
agent_proposals_offer_check.value: "agent_proposals"."offer" is null or ("agent_proposals"."offer" in ('open', 'used', 'dismissed', 'replaced') and "agent_proposals"."body" is not null and "agent_proposals"."target_kind" in ('strategy', 'plan', 'step'))

agent_runs_failed_reason_check.name: agent_runs_failed_reason_check
agent_runs_failed_reason_check.value: "agent_runs"."status" not in ('failed', 'refused') or "agent_runs"."status_reason" is not null

campaign_steps_output_account_check.name: campaign_steps_output_account_check
campaign_steps_output_account_check.value: ("campaign_steps"."output_connection" is null) = ("campaign_steps"."output_network_id" is null) and ("campaign_steps"."output_connection" is null or "campaign_steps"."type" = 'post')

campaign_steps_seo_setup_check.name: campaign_steps_seo_setup_check
campaign_steps_seo_setup_check.value: ("campaign_steps"."seo_setup" is null and "campaign_steps"."brief_run_id" is null) or "campaign_steps"."type" = 'seo_brief'

campaign_steps_dm_channel_check.name: campaign_steps_dm_channel_check
campaign_steps_dm_channel_check.value: ("campaign_steps"."type" = 'dm') = ("campaign_steps"."dm_channel" is not null) and ("campaign_steps"."dm_channel" is null or "campaign_steps"."dm_channel" in ('linkedin', 'x'))

campaigns_advance_check.name: campaigns_advance_check
campaigns_advance_check.value: "campaigns"."advance" = 'offer' or ("campaigns"."advance" = 'run' and "campaigns"."advance_set_by" is not null and "campaigns"."advance_time_zone" is not null)

standing_rules_template_mode_check.name: standing_rules_template_mode_check
standing_rules_template_mode_check.value: "standing_rules"."mode" <> 'template' or ("standing_rules"."template_revision" is not null and "standing_rules"."daily_cap" is not null and "standing_rules"."producer" is null)

standing_rules_agent_mode_check.name: standing_rules_agent_mode_check
standing_rules_agent_mode_check.value: "standing_rules"."mode" <> 'agent_written' or ("standing_rules"."template_revision" is null and "standing_rules"."daily_cap" is null and "standing_rules"."producer" is not null and "standing_rules"."allowed_facts" is not null and "standing_rules"."outside_content" = true and "standing_rules"."language" is not null and "standing_rules"."wording_version" is not null and "standing_rules"."drafting_agent" is not null)

prospect_companies_country_quote_check.name: prospect_companies_country_quote_check
prospect_companies_country_quote_check.value: "prospect_companies"."country" is not null or "prospect_companies"."country_quote" is null

prospect_companies_names_reason_check.name: prospect_companies_names_reason_check
prospect_companies_names_reason_check.value: ("prospect_companies"."names_status" is not distinct from 'skipped') = ("prospect_companies"."names_reason" is not null)

newsletter_settings_list_check.name: newsletter_settings_list_check
newsletter_settings_list_check.value: ("newsletter_settings"."list" = 'connected' and "newsletter_settings"."credential_id" is not null) or ("newsletter_settings"."list" = 'substack' and "newsletter_settings"."credential_id" is null)

media_removed_after_deleted_check.name: media_removed_after_deleted_check
media_removed_after_deleted_check.value: "media"."bytes_removed_at" is null or "media"."deleted_at" is not null

placement_grants_stop_check.name: placement_grants_stop_check
placement_grants_stop_check.value: ("placement_grants"."stopped_at" is null and "placement_grants"."stopped_by" is null and "placement_grants"."stop_reason" is null) or ("placement_grants"."answer" = 'yes' and "placement_grants"."stopped_at" is not null and length("placement_grants"."stop_reason") between 1 and 500)

competitor_changes_kind_check.name: competitor_changes_kind_check
competitor_changes_kind_check.value: ("competitor_changes"."kind" is null) = ("competitor_changes"."label" is distinct from 'answer') and ("competitor_changes"."kind" is null or "competitor_changes"."kind" in ('fact_update', 'comparison_page', 'post', 'ranking_brief'))

competitor_changes_labelled_check.name: competitor_changes_labelled_check
competitor_changes_labelled_check.value: ("competitor_changes"."label" is null) = ("competitor_changes"."labelled_at" is null) and ("competitor_changes"."label" is null) = ("competitor_changes"."reason" is null)
